cases.title: Basis state |000> (identity preparation)
cases.purpose: Full complex state-vector comparison against Qiskit Statevector (global phase normalized, index conventions mapped).
modelNotes: Qubit ordering: Qiskit little-endian (qubit 0 = LSB) vs Invention Lab q0-most-significant — resolved by index bit-reversal, then amplitudes compared element-wise.
Global phase is physically irrelevant: the comparison reports the phase it removed instead of reporting a false disagreement.
cases.toleranceRationale: max |amplitude| error after global-phase normalization < 1e-9: all engines compute the same unitary product in double precision; anything larger indicates a convention or implementation defect.

cases.title: QFT on |1> — H + controlled phases + swaps vs Qiskit Statevector and direct DFT
cases.purpose: Build the standard 3-qubit QFT circuit from its gate list (H, controlled phase rotations, SWAPs), run it on Invention Lab and Qiskit, and compare full state vectors. Additionally compare against the analytic DFT of |1>.
modelNotes: Controlled phases are expressed as CP gates in both engines; the index-order mapping is bit-reversal, identical to the other qubit cases.
cases.toleranceRationale: max amplitude error < 1e-9 after global-phase normalization (double precision unitary products); controlled-phase construction must match between the engines exactly.

checks.name: max |amplitude| error vs Qiskit (global phase normalized)
max |amplitude| error vs analytic DFT of |1>

cases.title: Bell-state measurement statistics (seeded sampler vs exact Qiskit distribution)
cases.purpose: Sample the Bell circuit 4000 times on Invention Lab (seeded mulberry32). The independent reference is the EXACT distribution from Qiskit Statevector — no RNG-vs-RNG sequence comparison is demanded; sampled counts must be consistent within 4 sigma of the binomial bound.
modelNotes: Invention Lab samples with mulberry32(seed); the exact distribution comes from Qiskit. No shared RNG, no shared stream.
cases.toleranceRationale: exact probabilities: abs 1e-9 (same unitary). Sampled counts: |p_sampled - p_exact| <= 4*sqrt(p(1-p)/N) — a statistically justified two-sided bound.

verdictDoc.pass: Invention Lab and the independent reference agree within the documented tolerance.
verdictDoc.fail: A comparison exceeded its tolerance or an engine produced invalid data.
verdictDoc.skipped: The benchmark did not run (e.g. external engine unavailable). NEVER counted as a pass.
verdictDoc.unsupported: The benchmark targets behavior the platform explicitly does not support.
verdictDoc.model-mismatch: The two engines implement genuinely different mathematical models; documented, not a bug.
verdictDoc.inconclusive: The benchmark ran but the comparison cannot decide (e.g. missing tolerance).
